functions.description: Parse hostd syslog envelope: timestamp, host, severity, pid, sub-component, opID, user and optional vm/task/sid/port/path context, plus trailing message text.
Extract source IP (IPv4, IPv6 or CIDR) from messages referencing 'from <ip>' such as failed logins, sessions, or firewall rules.
Extract subject user and source IPv4 from 'User <user>@<ip>' patterns in login/privilege event messages.
Classify hostd message into a normalized action taxonomy for downstream analytics.

add.name: action
add.value: message.match(/logged __e['in']/) ? 'login_success' : message.match(/Login failed/) ? 'login_failed' : message.match(/Session created/) ? 'session_created' : message.match(/Powering on/) ? 'power_on' : message.match(/PowerOff/) ? 'power_off' : message.match(/completed successfully/) ? 'task_success' : message.match(/Failed to mount/) ? 'mount_failed' : message.match(/attempted privileged operation/) ? 'privilege_denied' : message.match(/Certificate/) ? 'cert_expiry_warning' : message.match(/Firewall rule/) ? 'firewall_update' : message.match(/failed/) ? 'task_failed' : 'other'

functions.description: Derive protocol context when explicitly referenced in the hostd message text (NFS, iSCSI, HTTPS).
